contact.heading: Hey, I’m Rophy
contact.bio: I’m a Haitian-American multimedia producer and creative with roots in athletics and a passion for visual storytelling. Based in South Florida, available worldwide.

services.title: Match coverage
services.text: Matchday photo and video, from the tunnel and touchline to the stands.

services.title: Brand campaigns
services.text: Product launches, kit releases and campaign shoots with athletes.

services.title: Athlete content
services.text: Portraits, interviews and social-first video for players and clubs.
